purpose: Teach: 辞める/肩書き/党内/プロダクト/親会社/やりがい/チャネル/紛失

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、辞める、絶対、社員、絶対、ひとり、絶対、ひとり、絶対、見送ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I left every single employee with my blessing. Every one. That's the solemn truth I'm asking you to carry forward.
lines.style: Slow, measured cadence. Each phrase lands with deliberate weight. Slight pause between thoughts, as if placing stones. Voice steady and clear — not raising, but lowering into authority. The tone of someone passing down a vow.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、肩書き、絶対、お言葉、絶対、忘れません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I will never forget the values you taught me through your example — your integrity, your voice. I carry them with me.
lines.style: Respectful and direct. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Each word chosen carefully, not rushed. A man acknowledging he has truly listened. Slight breath after the opening — taking in what was said.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、業界、本気で、絶対、党内、絶対、政治、絶対、関わらなかったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I kept this company free from outside influence — no corporate parent, no political entanglement. That independence was sacred. Don't forget it.
lines.style: Quieter, almost reflective. The words carry memory in them. A slight weariness of someone who held firm against pressure. Pace slows on the final phrase, as if asking him to feel the weight of what was protected.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、プロダクト、絶対、誇りに、絶対、思った、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The purpose you showed me — the meaning in the work itself — that's alive in how I lead. That inheritance guides me every day.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost reverent. Speaking as if in the presence of something larger than himself. Each clause builds quietly. Voice carries the texture of someone who has lived by this lesson, not just heard it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、親会社、絶対、なし、絶対、独立した、絶対、商売、絶対、貫いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I built something truly independent — no parent company, no compromises. A business built on principle. Hold that line.
lines.style: Voice drops slightly, becoming more intimate. The words are firm but not harsh — a father's insistence wrapped in love. Deliberate pauses allow each idea to settle. Ends with quiet conviction, not force.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、やりがい、絶対、お話、絶対、心に残っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The care you took with every relationship, every detail — I see it. I honor it. It shapes everything I do.
lines.style: Gentle but grounded. A son speaking in full awareness of what was given to him. Not performative — sincere. Slight warmth in the voice, the kind that comes from deep gratitude. Finishes softly, like a promise kept.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お得意様への、絶対、チャネル、絶対、磨いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I polished every relationship with our most valued clients. That trust was earned, carefully, over years. Guard it like I did.
lines.style: Wistful and proud at once. Voice carries the memory of work done well. Quieter and slower, as if almost reluctant to let it go — but knowing he must. The tone of someone who built something that will outlast him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、書類、絶対、紛失、絶対、嫌った、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The way you despised carelessness, disorder — I feel that still. It's in my bones now. I carry that forward with gratitude and respect.
lines.style: Final and solemn. A man stepping into his father's shoes, fully aware of it. Voice is clear and warm but carries the weight of succession. Slight breath before the final phrase — taking on the responsibility completely. Ends with quiet finality.
